name: Darkness
description: Summons darkness around you in an 8 yd radius, granting friendly targets a 15% chance to avoid all damage from an attack. Lasts 8 sec.\n\nChance to avoid damage increased by 100% when not in a raid.

name: The Hunt
description: Charge to your target, striking them for 231 Chaos damage, rooting them in place for 1.5 sec and inflicting 168 Chaos damage over 6 sec to up to 5 enemies in your path.

name: Chaos Nova
description: Unleash an eruption of fel energy, dealing 9 Chaos damage and stunning all nearby enemies for 3 sec.

name: Imprison
description: Imprisons a demon, beast, or humanoid, incapacitating them for 1 min. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Essence Break
description: Slash all enemies in front of you for 110 Chaos damage, causing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance to deal 70 Chaos damage to them for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Eye Beam
description: Blasts all enemies in front of you, for up to 281 Chaos damage over 1.8 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Vengeful Retreat
description: Remove all snares and vault away. Nearby enemies take 5 Physical damage.

name: Felblade
description: Charge to your target and deal 43 Fire damage.\n\nGenerates 15 Fury.

name: Consume Magic
description: Consume 1 beneficial Magic effect removing it from the target.

name: Sigil of Misery
description: Place a Sigil of Misery at the target location that activates after 2 sec.\n\nCauses all enemies affected by the sigil to cower in fear, disorienting them for 15 sec.

name: Metamorphosis
description: Leap into the air and land with explosive force, dealing 15 Chaos damage to enemies within 8 yds, and stunning them for 3 sec. Players are Dazed for 3 sec instead.\n\nUpon landing, you are transformed into a hellish demon for 20 sec, greatly empowering your Chaos Strike and Blade Dance abilities and gaining 20% Haste.

name: Fury of the Illidari
description: Throws two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 0 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies.

name: Soul Carver
description: Carve into the soul of your target, dealing 171 Fire damage and an additional 105 Fire damage over 3 sec.  Immediately shatters 3 Soul Fragments from the target and 1 additional Soul Fragment every 1 sec.

name: Spectral Sight
description: Allows you to see enemies and treasures through physical barriers, as well as enemies that are stealthed and invisible. Lasts 8 sec.\n\nLoss of control effects disrupt the sight.

name: Blade Dance
description: Strike nearby enemies for 50 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Disrupt
description: Interrupts the enemy's spellcasting and locks them from that school of magic for 5 sec.

name: Immolation Aura
description: Engulf yourself in flames, radiating 29 Fire damage over 6 sec.

name: Fel Rush
description: Rush forward, incinerating anything in your path for 15 Chaos damage.

name: Glide
description: Reduces your falling speed.\n\nYou can activate this ability with the jump key while falling.

name: Blur
description: Reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Chaos Strike
description: Slice your target for 26 Chaos damage. Chaos Strike has a 20% chance to refund 20 Fury.

name: Demon's Bite
description: Quickly attack for 36 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 20 to 30 Fury.

name: Sigil of Flame
description:
Place a Sigil of Flame at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Deals 27 Fire damage, and an additional 70 Fire damage over 8 sec, to all enemies affected by the sigil.

Generates 25 Fury.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Throw Glaive
description: Throw a demonic glaive at the target, dealing 17 Physical damage. The glaive can ricochet to an additional enemy within 10 yards.

name: Torment
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Rain from Above
description: You fly into the air out of harm's way. While floating, you gain access to Fel Lance allowing you to deal damage to enemies below.

name: Illidan's Grasp
description: You strangle the target with demonic magic, stunning them in place and dealing 392 Shadow damage over 5 sec while the target is grasped. Can move while channeling.\n\nUse Illidan's Grasp again to toss the target to a location within 20 yards.

name: Reverse Magic
description: Removes all harmful magical effects from yourself and all nearby allies within 10 yards, and sends them back to their original caster if possible.

name: Blood Moon
description: Consume Magic now affects all enemies within 8 yards of the target and generates a Lesser Soul Fragment. Each effect consumed has a 5% chance to upgrade to a Greater Soul.

name: Cleansed by Flame
description: Immolation Aura dispels a magical effect on you when cast.

name: Cover of Darkness
description: The radius of Darkness is increased by 4 yds, and its duration by 2 sec.

name: Detainment
description: Imprison's PvP duration is increased by 1 sec, and targets become immune to damage and healing while imprisoned.

name: Glimpse
description: Vengeful Retreat provides immunity to loss of control effects, and reduces damage taken by 25% until you land.

name: Sigil Mastery
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Sigils by an additional 25%.

name: Unending Hatred
description: Taking damage causes you to gain Fury based on the damage dealt.

name: A Fire Inside
description: Immolation Aura has 1 additional charge, has 6 sec reduced cooldown, and deals Chaos damage instead of Fire.\n\nYou can have multiple Immolation Auras active at a time.

name: Accelerated Blade
description: Throw Glaive deals 60% increased damage, reduced by 30% for each previous enemy hit.

name: Aldrachi Design
description: Increases your chance to parry by 3%.

name: Aldrachi Tactics
description: The second enhanced ability in a pattern shatters an additional Soul Fragment.

name: Army Unto Oneself
description: Felblade surrounds you with a Blade Ward, reducing damage taken by 10% for 5 sec.

name: Art of the Glaive
description:
Consuming 20 Soul Fragments or casting Sigil of Spite converts your next Throw Glaive into Reaver's Glaive.

 Reaver's Glaive: 
Throw a glaive enhanced with the essence of consumed souls at your target, dealing 134 Physical damage and ricocheting to 2 additional enemies.
 
Begins a well-practiced pattern of glaivework, enhancing your next Shear and Soul Cleave.

The enhanced ability you cast first deals 10% increased damage, and the second deals 20% increased damage.

name: Aura of Pain
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Immolation Aura by 6%.

name: Bladecraft
description: Fury of the Aldrachi further empowers Blade Dance when cast after Chaos Strike, increasing slashes to 12.\n\nReaver's Mark now stacks up to 2 times and further empowers Chaos Strike when cast after Blade Dance, applying an additional stack.

name: Blazing Path
description: Shift gains an additional charge.

name: Blind Focus
description: Cosmic damage increased by 2%.\n\nEffect is doubled while in demon form.

name: Blind Fury
description: Eye Beam generates 30 Fury every second, has 10% increased duration, and deals 10% increased damage.

name: Bouncing Glaives
description: Throw Glaive ricochets to 1 additional target.

name: Broken Spirit
description: The Hunt shatters 1 Soul Fragment. Blade Dance and Chaos Strike have a 15% chance to shatter a Soul Fragment.

name: Burn It Out
description: Immolation Aura removes 1 Disease effect.

name: Burning Blades
description: Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.\n\nReap damage increased by 20%.

name: Burning Hatred
description: Immolation Aura generates an additional 24 Fury over 6 sec.

name: Burning Wound
description: Demon's Bite and Throw Glaive leave open wounds on your enemies, dealing 25 Chaos damage over 15 sec and increasing damage taken from your Immolation Aura by 35%.\n\nMay be applied to up to 3 targets.

name: Champion of the Glaive
description: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and 10 yard increased range.

name: Chaos Theory
description: Blade Dance causes your next Chaos Strike within 8 sec to have a 14-30% increased critical strike chance and will always refund Fury.

name: Chaotic Disposition
description: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 3 total times.

name: Chaotic Transformation
description: When you activate Metamorphosis, the cooldowns of Blade Dance and Eye Beam are immediately reset.

name: Charred Warblades
description: You heal for 3% of all Fire damage you deal.

name: Collective Anguish
description: Eye Beam summons an allied Vengeance Demon Hunter who casts Fel Devastation, dealing 92 Fire damage over 2 sec. Dealing damage heals you for up to 49 health.

name: Critical Chaos
description: The chance that Chaos Strike will refund 20 Fury is increased by 30% of your critical strike chance.

name: Cycle of Hatred
description: Activating Eye Beam reduces the cooldown of your next Eye Beam by 2.5 sec, stacking up to 10 sec.

name: Dancing with Fate
description: The final slash of Blade Dance deals an additional 25% damage.

name: Dash of Chaos
description: For 2 sec after using Fel Rush, activating it again will dash back towards your initial location.

name: Deflecting Dance
description: You deflect incoming attacks while Blade Dancing, absorbing damage up to 15% of your maximum health.

name: Demon Hide
description: Magical damage increased by 3%, and Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.

name: Demon Muzzle
description: Interrupting a spell with Disrupt decreases your magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

name: Demonic
description: Eye Beam causes you to enter demon form for 5 sec after it finishes dealing damage.

name: Demonic Intensity
description: Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.\n\nVoidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.

name: Demonic Resilience
description: Blur gains 1 additional charge.

name: Demonsurge
description: Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.\n\nWhile demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing 2,372 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Desperate Instincts
description: Blur now reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.\n\nAdditionally, damage taken below 35% Health is reduced by 10%.

name: Disrupting Fury
description: Disrupt generates 30 Fury on a successful interrupt.

name: Enduring Torment
description: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.

name: Erratic Felheart
description: The cooldown of Fel Rush is reduced by 1.0 sec.

name: Eternal Hunt
description: The Hunt empowers your next Eye Beam, increasing damage by 100% and affecting enemies in a wider area.

name: Evasive Action
description: Vengeful Retreat can be cast a second time within 3 sec.

name: Exergy
description: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase your damage by 5% for 20 sec.

name: Felbound
description: Your movement speed is increased by 3%.

name: Felfire Haste
description: Fel Rush increases your movement speed by 10% for 8 sec.

name: Final Breath
description: Fully channeling Void Ray increases the damage of its final tick by 300%.

name: First Blood
description: Blade Dance deals 95 Chaos damage to the first target struck.

name: First In, Last Out
description: Shift grants you a rapidly decaying shield equal to 6% of your maximum health.

name: Flamebound
description: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.

name: Focused Hatred
description: Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.\n\nEach additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.

name: Focused Ire
description: The primary target of Chaos Nova is stunned for an additional 2 sec.

name: Furious
description: Attacks and abilities that generate Fury deal 3% increased damage.

name: Furious Gaze
description: When Eye Beam finishes fully channeling, your Haste is increased by an additional 8% for 8 sec.

name: Furious Throws
description: Throw Glaive now costs 25 Fury and throws a second glaive at the target.

name: Fury of the Aldrachi
description: When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Soul Cleave casts 3 additional glaive slashes to nearby targets. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.\n\nIf cast after Shear, cast 6 slashes instead.

name: Glaive Tempest
description: The final slash of Blade Dance consumes 25 Fury when it strikes 3 or more enemies, launching two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 66 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Growing Inferno
description: Immolation Aura's damage increases by 10% each time it deals damage.

name: Illidari Knowledge
description: Reduces magic damage taken by 3%.

name: Improved Chaos Strike
description: Chaos Strike damage increased by 10%.

name: Improved Disrupt
description: Increases the range of Disrupt to 10 yds.

name: Improved Sigil of Misery
description: Reduces the cooldown of Sigil of Misery by 30 sec.

name: Improved Soul Rending
description: Leech granted by Soul Rending increased by 2% and an additional 2% while Void Metamorphosis is active.

name: Incisive Blade
description: Soul Cleave deals 10% increased damage.

name: Incorruptible Spirit
description: Each Soul Fragment you consume shields you for an additional 15% of the amount healed.

name: Inertia
description: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat cause your next Fel Rush or Felblade to empower you, increasing damage by 18% for 5 sec.

name: Infernal Armor
description: Immolation Aura increases your armor by 20% and causes melee attackers to suffer 4 Fire damage.

name: Initiative
description: Damaging an enemy before they damage you increases your critical strike chance by 10% for 5 sec.\n\nVengeful Retreat refreshes your potential to trigger this effect on any enemies you are in combat with.

name: Inner Demon
description: Entering demon form causes your next Chaos Strike to unleash your inner demon, causing it to crash into your target and deal 74 Chaos damage to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Internal Struggle
description: Increases your mastery by 2.6%.

name: Isolated Prey
description:
Chaos Nova, Eye Beam, and Immolation Aura gain bonuses when striking 1 target.

 Chaos Nova:
Stun duration increased by 2 sec.

 Eye Beam:
Deals 30% increased damage.

 Immolation Aura:
Always critically strikes.

name: Keen Edge
description: Reaver's Glaive damage is increased by 20% and other Physical-only damage is increased by 10%.

name: Keen Engagement
description: Reaver's Glaive generates 20 Fury.

name: Know Your Enemy
description: Gain critical strike damage equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.

name: Live by the Glaive
description: When you parry an attack or have one of your attacks parried, restore 2% of max health and 10 Fury. \n\nThis effect may only occur once every 5 sec.

name: Long Night
description: Increases the duration of Darkness by 3 sec.

name: Lost in Darkness
description: Spectral Sight has 5 sec reduced cooldown and no longer reduces movement speed.

name: Master of the Glaive
description: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and snares all enemies hit by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Monster Rising
description: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.

name: Mortal Dance
description: Blade Dance now reduces targets' healing received by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Pitch Black
description: Reduces the cooldown of Darkness by 120 sec.

name: Preemptive Strike
description: Throw Glaive deals 7 Physical damage to enemies near its initial target.

name: Pursuit
description: Mastery increases your movement speed.

name: Pursuit of Angriness
description: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.

name: Ragefire
description: Each time Immolation Aura deals damage, 35% of the damage dealt by up to 3 critical strikes is gathered as Ragefire.\n\nWhen Immolation Aura expires you explode, dealing all stored Ragefire damage to nearby enemies.

name: Reaver's Mark
description: When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Shear applies Reaver's Mark, which causes the target to take 7% increased damage for 20 sec. Max 2 stacks.\n\nApplies 1 additional stack of Reaver's Mark If cast after Soul Cleave.

name: Relentless Onslaught
description: Chaos Strike has a 10% chance to trigger a second Chaos Strike.

name: Remorseless
description: Attacks and abilities that spend Fury deal 3% increased damage.

name: Scars of Suffering
description: Increases Versatility by 4% and reduces threat generated by 8%.

name: Screaming Brutality
description: Blade Dance automatically triggers Throw Glaive on your primary target for 100% damage and each slash has a 50% chance to Throw Glaive an enemy for 35% damage.

name: Serrated Glaive
description: Enemies hit by Chaos Strike or Throw Glaive take 15% increased damage from Chaos Strike and Throw Glaive for 15 sec.

name: Set Fire to the Pain
description: 5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.\n\nFire damage taken reduced by 10%.

name: Shattered Destiny
description: The duration of your active demon form is extended by 0.1 sec per 12 Fury spent.

name: Shattered Restoration
description: The healing of Shattered Souls is increased by 10%.

name: Soul Cleanse
description: Immolation Aura removes 1 Curse effect.

name: Soul Rending
description: Leech increased by 6%.\n\nGain an additional 6% leech while Metamorphosis is active.

name: Soul Splitter
description: Any time you would generate one or more Soul Fragments, you have a 2% chance to generate an additional Soul Fragment.

name: Soulscar
description: Throw Glaive causes targets to take an additional 80% of damage dealt as Chaos over 6 sec.

name: Student of Suffering
description: Void Ray applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 10.6% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.

name: Swallowed Anger
description: Consume Magic generates 20 Fury when a beneficial Magic effect is successfully removed from the target.

name: Tactical Retreat
description: Vengeful Retreat has a 5 sec reduced cooldown and generates 80 Fury over 10 sec.

name: Thrill of the Fight
description: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.

name: Trail of Ruin
description: The final slash of Blade Dance inflicts an additional 25 Chaos damage over 4 sec.

name: Unbound Chaos
description: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase the damage of your next Fel Rush or Felblade by 300%. Lasts 12 sec.

name: Undying Embers
description: Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.

name: Unhindered Assault
description: Vengeful Retreat resets the cooldown of Felblade.

name: Unrestrained Fury
description: Increases maximum Fury by 20.

name: Untethered Fury
description: Maximum Fury increased by 20.

name: Vengeful Bonds
description: Vengeful Retreat reduces the movement speed of all nearby enemies by 70% for 3 sec.

name: Violent Transformation
description: Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.\n\nThe Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.

name: Volatile Instinct
description: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.

name: Warblade's Hunger
description: Consuming a Soul Fragment causes your next Shear to deal 21 additional Physical damage.

name: Wave of Debilitation
description: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.

name: Will of the Illidari
description: Increases maximum health by 3%.

name: Wings of Wrath
description: Glide speed increased by 10%.

name: Wounded Quarry
description: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.
